name: Apple M4 Ultra (Mac Studio, 2025)
memory_bandwidth_basis: Apple M4 Ultra spec: 819 GB/s unified memory
notes: Largest M4-generation Apple Silicon part; two M4 Max dies fused. Up to 192 GB unified memory (some SKUs 256 GB). Aggregate siliconscore benchmarks file it as 'M4 Ultra (192 GB)'. Decode scales roughly with 819 GB/s. CONTESTED 2026-10-19: this record's only source is a machine-level benchmark CSV, and its specs (192 GB @ 819 GB/s) are identical to apple-m3-ultra, which is sourced to Apple's own spec sheet. No Apple document for an M4 Ultra was found; an M4 Max is 546 GB/s. Treat the machine label as unsupported - see [[gotchas/aa-gotcha-m4-ultra-is-a-mislabeled-m3-ultra-mac-studio]]. The 16 benchmarks that cite this id are measured figures and are unaffected. VERIFIED 2026-10-23 [NO SOURCE PUBLISHES THIS FIGURE]: https://support.apple.com/en-us/120021. Specs unsupported; machine label likely mislabeled M3 Ultra.
